freezeEvidence.method: Independently recomputed append-only sampling, percentile values, counts and draws, including both boundary-discriminator branches
freezeEvidence.scope: Declared scalar sampling cases only; no RGBA pipeline acceptance

provenance: Coordinator-derived analytic descriptors, not production execution or blind held-out evidence

boundaryDiscriminator.derivation: At percentile zero an appended zero becomes the minimum; rejecting it leaves only ones. This discriminates the threshold without exposing internal sample counts.

derivation: Sort accepted values and index floor(sampleCount*percentile). All values before sample count40000 are retained without random draws. Later candidates append only when random<0.1, never replace existing values.
limitations: Source selects percentile0.9; other percentiles discriminate the generalized clone helper
